normal.text: Adnan made a one-off joke in this last Sad Bois episode where I was talking about how I was more excited for a couple of random cozy "girly" games coming out on Steam than I am for GTAVI. And he just said "I need you to play the Dressmaking game so we know how good it is." I wasn't planning on it...

When I played TF2 I almost exclusively played high tower payload race as pyro and not much else. That games really good about satisfying gameplay loops that manage to be simultaneously relaxing AND competitive somehow
